qualification.implementations: Preserve specific upstream sources, attribution and licenses; adapt to the suite's exact workload contracts using idiomatic Luau.
qualification.host_interface: The standalone Luau VM omits operating-system I/O. Any authored embedding and general library bindings must be retained, disclosed and counted according to their source roles. Benchmark algorithms remain in Luau.
qualification.correctness: Run the shared bounded corpus in both execution modes, validate full outputs, and inspect required algorithmic work before admitting timings.
qualification.source_size: Count normalized source units including all authored application helpers and meaningful directives; preserve any unsupported formatted-LOC metric as unavailable.
qualification.timing: Three fresh complete-process samples per admitted program and execution mode, with startup, source/bytecode loading, execution-time compilation, input, complete computation/output and shutdown included. Runtime build is outside the interval.
qualification.contention: Use the shared timing mutex; run measurements sequentially with no simultaneous compilation or competing benchmark jobs.
qualification.preservation: Existing timings, source bytes, exclusions and baselines remain unchanged unless a separately qualified normalization update is required.
qualification.admission: Only measured, validated full-size programs enter the plotted catalog; no estimates or placeholder timings.
